rows.name: Psionic Aptitude
rows.description: Can gain 1 power point instead of 1 hit point or 1 skill rank when taking a level in a favored class.

rows.name: Naturally Psionic
rows.description: Gain the Wild Talent feat, or Psionic Talent if levels in a psionic class taken.

rows.name: Pariah
rows.description: -1 to Cha-based skill checks with non-goblinoid humanoids, +1 to Cha-based skill checks with goblins.

rows.name: Repletion
rows.description: Spend 1 power point to not need to eat or drink for 24 hours.

rows.name: Keen Senses
rows.description: Blues receive a +2 bonus on Perception skill checks.

rows.name: Stealthy
rows.description: +2 on Stealth and Ride; Stealth always a class skill.

rows.name: Weapon Familiarity
rows.description: Blues treat any weapon with the word "goblin" in it as a martial weapon.

rows.name: Goblinoid Camouflage
rows.description: Gain a +10 on Disguise checks to appear as a normal goblin for 24 hours by spending 1 pp.

rows.name: Kinslayer
rows.description: Gain +1 on attack rolls against goblinoids.

rows.name: Leadership
rows.description: Gain a +2 bonus on Diplomacy checks.

rows.name: Mindbender
rows.description: Gain +1 on DC of compulsion powers.

rows.name: Psionic Prodigy
rows.description: Gain Unlocked Talent as a bonus feat.

rows.name: Self Reliant
rows.description: Gain +3 on Survival chekcs, -1 on Diplomacy checks.

rows.name: Chitin
rows.description: Dromites receive a +1 natural armor bonus and one type of energy resistance 5.

rows.name: Compound Eyes
rows.description: Dromites receive a +2 bonus on Perception Skill checks.

rows.name: Atavistic Link
rows.description: Others can contact your mind more easily.

rows.name: Crafter
rows.description: Gain +%1 on chosen craft skill.

rows.name: Excavator
rows.description: Treat Strength as 4 higher for carrying capacity; base move becomes 20 ft, but not slowed by encumbrance.

rows.name: Gendered
rows.description: Gain +3 bonus on Diplomacy checks on dromites.

rows.name: Hive Mind
rows.description: Gain mindlink as an at-will psi-like ability.

rows.name: Hive Soldier
rows.description: Gain claw attacks.

rows.name: Aberrant Nature
rows.description: -1 penalty to CHA-based skill checks when dealing with non-Elans.

rows.name: Resistance
rows.description: As immediate action, spend 1 power point to gain +4 on saves until next action.

rows.name: Resilience
rows.description: As immediate action, reduce damage about to be taken by 2 per 1 power point spent.

rows.name: Repletion
rows.description: Spend 1 power point to not need to eat or drink for 24 hours.

rows.name: Failed Transformation (Blue)
rows.description: Gain Darkvision and Small Blue traits.

rows.name: Failed Transformation (Dromite)
rows.description: Gain Chitin Dromite traits.

rows.name: Failed Transformation (Duergar)
rows.description: Gain Darkvision and Slow and Steady Duergar traits.

rows.name: Failed Transformation (Dwarf)
rows.description: Gain Darkvision and Slow and Steady Dwarf traits.

rows.name: Failed Transformation (Elf)
rows.description: Gain Low-Light Vision and Elven Immunities Elf traits.

rows.name: Failed Transformation (Gnome)
rows.description: Gain Low-Light Vision and Keen Senses Gnome traits.

rows.name: Failed Transformation (Half-Elf)
rows.description: Gain Adaptability and Low-Light Vision Half-Elf traits.

rows.name: Failed Transformation (Half-Giant)
rows.description: Gain Fire Acclimated and Low-Light Vision Half-Giant traits.

rows.name: Failed Transformation (Half-Orc)
rows.description: Gain Darkvision and Ferocity Half-Orc traits.

rows.name: Failed Transformation (Halfling)
rows.description: Gain Halfling Luck and Keen Senses Halfling traits.

rows.name: Failed Transformation (Human)
rows.description: Gain Skilled Human trait.

rows.name: Failed Transformation (Maenad)
rows.description: Gain Sonic Affinity and Outburst Maenad traits.

rows.name: Failed Transformation (Ophiduan)
rows.description: Gain Scaled Hide and Poison Resistant Ophiduan traits.

rows.name: Failed Transformation (Xeph)
rows.description: Gain Darkvision and Burst (1/day) Xeph traits.

rows.name: Haughty
rows.description: Gain +2 saves vs. mind-affecting effects, and -2 penalty to Charisma-based skills with non-elans.

rows.name: Reconstruction
rows.description: Spend pp to gain fast healing; +1 manifester level for Healing powers.

rows.name: Smooth Talker
rows.description: Gain +2 on Charisma-based skills against non-mindless creatures.

rows.name: Strong Blooded (Blue)
rows.description: Spend a power point for +2 on Stealth for a round.

rows.name: Strong Blooded (Dromite)
rows.description: Spend a power point for energy resistance 5 against active energy type for a round.

rows.name: Strong Blooded (Duergar)
rows.description: Spend a power point for +2 on CMD against bull rush and trip for a round while on ground.

rows.name: Strong Blooded (Dwarf)
rows.description: Spend a power point to gain Stonecunning for a minute.

rows.name: Strong Blooded (Elf)
rows.description: Spend a power point to gain low-light vision for a minute.

rows.name: Strong Blooded (Gnome)
rows.description: Spend a power point for +2 saves against illusions for a minute.

rows.name: Strong Blooded (Half-Elf)
rows.description: Spend a power point for +2 on Perception for a round.

rows.name: Strong Blooded (Half-Giant)
rows.description: Spend a power point to gain Powerful Build for a round.

rows.name: Strong Blooded (Half-Orc)
rows.description: Spend a power point for +2 on Intimidate for a round.

rows.name: Strong Blooded (Halfling)
rows.description: Spend a power point for +2 on Acrobatics for a round.

rows.name: Strong Blooded (Human)
rows.description: Spend a power point for +1 on a skill check in a round.

rows.name: Strong Blooded (Maenad)
rows.description: Spend a power point for +2 on Strength, -2 on Intelligence and Wisdom for a round.

rows.name: Strong Blooded (Ophiduan)
rows.description: Spend a power point for +1 natural armor for a round.

rows.name: Strong Blooded (Xeph)
rows.description: Spend a power point for +10 base speed for a round.

rows.name: Slow and Steady
rows.description: You have a base speed of 20 feet, but your speed is never modified by armor or encumbrance.

rows.name: Fearless
rows.description: You gain a +2 bonus against fear effects.

rows.name: Natural Armor
rows.description: You have a +%1 natural armor bonus to your AC.

rows.name: Source Crystal
rows.description: Unlike most half-constructs, you can be raised and resurrected.

rows.name: Crystal Skin
rows.description: You gain a +2 AC bonus against ray attacks.  1/day, you can deflect one ray as an immediate action.

rows.name: Memory Matrix
rows.description: You gain a +2 bonus to a chosen Craft, Knowledge, or Profession skill.

rows.name: Oreheart
rows.description: You can be raised and resurrected, and also healed by repair effects as if you were a construct.  You only heal half as much from healing effects, and take only half damage from negative energy effects.

rows.name: Quickened Steps
rows.description: You have a speed of 30 ft.

rows.name: Second Skin
rows.description: You reduce any armor check penalty from armor worn by 1 and can sleep in medium or heavy metal armor without suffering ill effects from sleeping in armor.

rows.name: Strange Mind
rows.description: You gain a +2 bonus to Will saves and an additional +2 bonus against illusion spells or effects.

rows.name: Giant Blood
rows.description: Half-Giants count as human and giant for any effect related to race.

rows.name: Fire Acclimated
rows.description: +2 racial bonus on saves vs. fire spells and effects.

rows.name: Powerful Build
rows.description: Can be treated as one size larger if advantageous for size modifier for opposed checks, special attacks affected by size, and using weapons.  This stacks with other size-changing effects.

rows.name: Survivor
rows.description: +4 to Survival checks.

rows.name: Cold Acclimated
rows.description: +2 saves vs. cold.

rows.name: Flame of Freedom
rows.description: +1 manifester level on fire powers.

rows.name: Juggernaut
rows.description: +1 CMB with bull rush, overrun, and trip.

rows.name: Liberty or Death
rows.description: +2 saves vs. mind-affecting effects.

rows.name: Psionic Resonance
rows.description: +2 bonus to Use Magic Device to activate an item or use a power stone.

rows.name: Sonic Affinity
rows.description: +1 DC to any sonic power or spell.

rows.name: Outburst
rows.description: Spend 1 power point/round to get +%1 STR, -2 INT, -2 WIS.

rows.name: Inner Rage
rows.description: You are able to rage for %1 extra rounds per day.  You may also use these rounds to fuel Outburst, instead of power points.

rows.name: Ordered Rage
rows.description: Maenads may take levels in the Barbarian class even if they are lawful.

rows.name: Natural Sailor
rows.description: +2 bonus to Swim and Profession (Sailor); +2 bonus to Acrobatics and Climb made on sailing ships.

rows.name: Weapon Familiarity
rows.description: Maenads are proficient with flails, and treat any weapon with the word "maenad" in it as a martial weapon.

rows.name: Born to Lead
rows.description: +2 on Diplomacy and Knowledge (Nobility); proficiency with rapier and whip.

rows.name: Crystal Resonance
rows.description: +1 manifester level for psionic tattoo, and can use Sonic Affinity with sonic tattoos.

rows.name: Crystallized Skin
rows.description: Gain +1 natural armor.

rows.name: Shore-Bound
rows.description: +2 to Acrobatics checks on the ground.

rows.name: Tempestuous Temper
rows.description: You are treated as Lawful when focused, Chaotic when not.  You may expend focus to gain +2 Strength, -2 Intelligence, -2 Wisdom for a turn.

rows.name: Symbiotic Resistance
rows.description: You gain a +2 racial bonus on saves against disease and mind-affecting effects.

rows.name: Symbiotic Surge
rows.description: Add 1d6 to a 1d20 roll %1/day.

rows.name: Gift of Tongues
rows.description: You gain a +1 bonus on Bluff and Diplomacy checks, and learn an additional language every time you put a rank in the Linguistics skill.

rows.name: Empathic Persuasion
rows.description: You gain empathic connection as a psi-like ability.

rows.name: Feral Erliss
rows.description: You gain two claw attacks and a +2 racial bonus on Survival checks.

rows.name: Master of Deception
rows.description: You gain a +4 racial bonus on Bluff checks to convince an opponent that what you are saying is true.  Once per day you can roll twice when making a Bluff or Diplomacy check and take the better roll.

rows.name: Resilient Symbiote
rows.description: You gain vigor as a psi-like ability.

rows.name: Symbiote Sensitivity
rows.description: You gain detect psionics as a psi-like ability.

rows.name: Symbiotic Sentry
rows.description: When you fail a save against a mind-affecting effect, you may immediately roll a second save; if the second save is successful, you are still affected by the effect, but you are at least aware of a psychic attack and your failure to block it, even if you do not know the exact attack or its consequences.  Once per day, if the second save is successful, you may choose to use that result in place of the first roll.

rows.name: Unbonded
rows.description: You have chosen to not be bonded to an erliss.

rows.name: Scaled Hide
rows.description: Ophiduans get +1 natural armor.

rows.name: Poison Resistant
rows.description: Ophiduans get +2 racial bonus on saves against poison.

rows.name: Weapon Familiarity
rows.description: Ophiduans treat any weapon with the word "ophiduan" in it as a martial weapon.

rows.name: Serpent's Bite
rows.description: 1/day, for 1 minute, gain %1d8 bite attack.  Manifester Level %2.

rows.name: Deformed
rows.description: Gain Slow and Steady and +2 natural armor, but -2 to Diplomacy.

rows.name: Metabolist
rows.description: You are treated as one level higher when manifesting psychometabolism powers with personal range.

rows.name: Poisonous Flesh
rows.description: Use prevenom or prevenom weapon once per day.

rows.name: Scholar
rows.description: Choose one Knowledge skill; gain it as a class skill, and get +2 on the skill.

rows.name: Slippery Hide
rows.description: Gain +2 to CMD vs. Grapple, Escape Artist, and to escape a grapple.

rows.name: Innate Resistance
rows.description: Xephs get +1 on saves vs. powers, spells, and spell-like effects.

rows.name: Burst
rows.description: %2/day as a swift action, burst of speed for 3 rounds, +%1 competence bonus to speed.

rows.name: Bladeborn
rows.description: Gain Quick Draw and Exotic Weapon Proficiency (Xephyr Knife).

rows.name: Call Blade
rows.description: Gain call weaponry as a psilike ability.

rows.name: Explorer
rows.description: Gain +2 on Knowledge (Geography) and Survival checks, and treat manifester level as one higher for willing-target psychoportation powers.

rows.name: Quick Craftsman
rows.description: Reduce item creation time by half.

rows.name: Troubadour
rows.description: Gain +1 on Diplomacy and Perform; can retry some failed Diplomacy checks.

rows.name: Windweaver
rows.description: Gain +1 dodge bonus to AC.

rows.name: Natural Invisibility
rows.description: This ability is constant--this astral construct remains invisible at all times, even when attacking. As this ability is inherent, it is not subject to the eradicate invisibility power. Against foes that cannot pinpoint it, this astral construct gains a +20 bonus on Stealth checks when moving, or +40 when standing still--these bonuses are not included in the statistics above.

rows.name: Armor Spikes
rows.description: Do extra 1d6 piercing damage with trample, constrict, bull rush, or grapple attack.

rows.name: Talons
rows.description: Slam attacks do either slashing or piercing damage.

rows.name: Utility
rows.description: The astral construct can perform various tasks up to DC %1.

rows.name: Stunning Fist
rows.description: The astral construct can use Stunning Fist with its slam attacks.

rows.name: Link
rows.description: An ectopic artisan and his astral warrior share a mental link that allows for communication across any distance (as long as they are on the same plane). This communication is a free action, allowing the ectopic artisan to give orders to his astral warrior at any time. In addition, magic items interfere with the ectopic artisan's connection to his astral warrior. As a result, the ectopic artisan and his astral warrior share magic item slots. For example, if the ectopic artisan is wearing a ring, his astral warrior can wear no more than one ring. In case of a conflict, the items worn by the ectopic artisan remain active, and those used by the astral warrior become dormant.

rows.name: Ectoplasmic Poison
rows.description: Swarm - injury; save Fort DC %1; frequency 1/round for 2 rounds; effect 1d3 Dexterity drain; cure 1 save.

rows.name: Link
rows.description: A nightmare constructor and his horror share a mental link that allows for communication across any distance (as long as they are on the same plane). This communication is a free action, allowing the nightmare constructor to give orders to his horror at any time. In addition, magic items interfere with the nightmare constructor's connection to his horror. As a result, the nightmare constructor and his horror share magic item slots. For example, if the nightmare constructor is wearing a ring, his horror can wear no more than one ring. In case of a conflict, the items worn by the nightmare constructor remain active, and those used by the horror become dormant.

rows.name: Devastating Touch
rows.description: Melee touch on living target deals %1d%2+%3 damage.

rows.name: Construct Traits
rows.description: A psicrystal cannot heal damage, but it can be repaired. Psicrystals do not have the usual construct traits of darkvision and low-light vision.

rows.name: Hardness
rows.description: A psicrystal has hardness 8.

rows.name: Skills
rows.description: A psicrystal has the same skill ranks as its owner, except that it has a minimum of 4 ranks each in Perception and Stealth.

rows.name: Self Propulsion
rows.description: The psicrystal can grow spidery legs that give it a move of 30', 20' climb.

rows.name: Telepathic Link
rows.description: Owner and psicrystal can communicate telepathically up to 1 mile away.

rows.name: Share Powers
rows.description: The owner can have any power that he manifests on himself affect the psicrystal, if the psicrystal is within 5 feet.   The owner can manifest a power with Target:You on the Psicrystal instead.

rows.name: Deliver Touch Powers
rows.description: The psicrystal can deliver a touch power if the psicrystal is touching the owner when the owner manifests the power.

rows.name: Telepathic Speech
rows.description: The psicrystal can communicate with any creature that has a language within 30 feet, if the psicrystal is also within 1 mile of its owner.

rows.name: Power Resistance
rows.description: The psicrystal has power resistance %1.

rows.name: Sight Link
rows.description: The owner can remote view the psicrystal 1/day.

rows.name: Channel Power
rows.description: The owner can manifest powers through the psicrystal if the psicrystal is up to 1 mile away.

rows.name: Sighted
rows.description: The psicrystal can sense its environment as though it can see and hear, even in magical darkness and silence.
